analogy.rationale: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors act on CA isoforms and related ion transporters (SLC12A1/3) that are largely kidney-specific, so most cell lines should show little transcriptional response; thiazide diuretics and SLC12 transporter inhibitors share the renal ion-transport pathway and are the closest expected analogs.
